PHYSICAL EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.

   C. Disrupt classmates during Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
